summary: the case machine.installer.stick-update on i686, through tests/run installer, on the install stick made by the rule of mk/images.mk

argv: tag=; [ ! -f krffs/recovery_authorized_keys ] || tag=-with-key; make -s -j8 rach2 rach2-recovery-image build/images/rach2-recovery$tag.iso build/tools/image/mkmbr build/tools/image/stickcheck build/tests/host/mkexfatfixture ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f build/images/rach2-install-stick$tag.img build/images/cases/install-stick.img && make -s build/images/rach2-install-stick$tag.img ARCH=i686 </dev/null && shasum -a 256 < build/images/rach2-install-stick$tag.img > ${WORK}/stick.sha256
ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run installer 'run: installer: PASS'

faults.name: root
faults.summary: the stick is made with no root image, which the test must report as missing

faults.name: reserve
faults.summary: the stick's volume has 4 MiB of free space in place of 256, too little for the saved partitions
